paragraphs: The Discovery D250 is part of the fifth-generation Discovery range (L462, 2017–present), using the Ingenium AJ200D 2.0-litre four-cylinder diesel. The D250 sits in the middle of the diesel lineup, offering a balance of power and efficiency. Like other JLR Ingenium diesel models, it uses the same engine family as the D300 and D350 but with a lower output tune.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace AJ200D (Ingenium) engines for every Discovery D250 on the road.

compatibility.intro: Because the Discovery D250 uses a specific tune of the Ingenium AJ200D diesel, getting the right matching is essential. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm:

points.text: Your exact engine code (AJ200D (Ingenium)) via registration or VIN
Whether your build falls in the early production period (2019-2020) for injector fault coverage

compatibility.footer: This is why we always start with your registration rather than a generic Defender quote — it protects you from paying for parts that don't fit your actual car.
